events.name: LSU Tigers at Auburn Tigers

highlights.headline: Highlight: 6-seed Auburn beats 14-seed LSU, advances to quarterfinals
highlights.description: Chase Fralick and Eric Guevara each go yard for Auburn as Brandon McCraine earns a run as well to seal the 3-1 win over the opposing Tigers, sealing their spot in the SEC quarterfinals.

events.name: Georgia State Panthers at Southern Miss Golden Eagles
Tennessee Volunteers at Arkansas Razorbacks

highlights.headline: Highlight: 7-seed Arkansas mashes four homers to defeat 10-seed Tennessee
highlights.description: The Razorbacks get two moon shots from Zack Stewart, as Camden Kozeal and TJ Pompey also go yard to eliminate the Vols in the SEC Tournament, 8-4.

events.name: Missouri Tigers at Mississippi State Bulldogs

highlights.headline: Highlight: Eight-spot for 8-seed MS State buries 16-seed Missouri
highlights.description: Mississippi State uses an eight-run sixth inning to end Mizzou's SEC Tournament and season in run-rule fashion, 12-2.
